success_patterns: When hotel check-in or checkout dates are missing, ask for them instead of inventing dates from occasions or vague timing; this recurs across multiple hotel requests.
For explicitly requested round trips, treat outbound and return as separate directional legs and apply the stated flight class to each.

patch.reasoning: Both recurring patterns are already covered by the required-argument checks and flight-itinerary sections, so no skill edits are warranted.
